message.content:
Based on my search, here's how to access your **Wells Fargo credit card login**:

## How to Log In to Your Wells Fargo Credit Card Account

### Online (Desktop/Laptop)
1. Go to the official Wells Fargo website: **https://www.wellsfargo.com**
2. Click **"Sign On"** in the upper right corner
3. Enter your **Username** and **Password**
4. Click **"Sign On"** to access your account dashboard

### Mobile App
1. Download the **Wells Fargo Mobile® app** from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android)
2. Open the app and tap **"Sign On"**
3. Enter your username and password (same as online banking)
4. You can enable **Face ID, Touch ID, or biometric login** for faster future access

### First-Time Users (Enrollment)
If you haven't enrolled yet:
1. Click **"Enroll"** on the sign-on page
2. Enter your **credit card number**, **Social Security Number**, and **date of birth** to verify your identity
3. Create a username and password
4. Set up security questions

## What You Can Do Once Logged In
- View balances and transaction history
- Make payments (one-time or set up AutoPay)
- View and download statements
- Set up account alerts
- Lock/unlock your card if lost or stolen
- Request a credit limit increase
- Dispute transactions
- Redeem rewards (for eligible cards)

## Forgot Your Login?
- Click **"Forgot Password/Username?"** on the sign-on page
- Verify your identity with your card number, SSN, and other personal information
- Reset your credentials via email or text verification

## Customer Service
If you need help, call **1-800-642-4720** or the number on the back of your credit card.

---

**Security Tips:**
- Never save your password on shared devices
- Enable two-factor authentication when available
- Avoid using public WiFi for banking
- Wells Fargo will never ask for your password via email or phone
